review_candidates.description: At Warner Music Group, We’re a Global Collective Of Music Makers And Music Lovers, Tech Innovators And Inspired Entrepreneurs, Game-changing Creatives And Passionate Team Members. Here, We Turn Dreams Into Stardom And Audiences Into Fans. We Are Guided By Three Core Values That Underpin Everything We Do Across All Our Diverse Businesses Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans. Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises. Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights – technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog ! WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences. Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent. The new Forward Deployed Engineering Team within the Data and Insights Organization in WMG Global Tech is a specialized capability that focuses on solving a diverse range of problems across our business. This team will partner with our Product Solutions team and work with our key business stakeholders across Warner Music Group to rapidly build and deploy automation and solutions using data and AI. If you love working directly with customers on a variety of different problems while using world-class data platforms to create awesome solutions, and you’ve got strong software engineering and data fundamentals, this role might be a great fit. We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our organization. As an FDE, you will work directly with our most important business stakeholders across labels and global functions to deliver rapid solutions leveraging data and AI. Strong candidates will thrive when partnering with non-technical customers, have great product instincts, lots of empathy, and can intersect AI solutions with their pain points to turn painful tasks that take weeks into workflows that take minutes. This role entails full stack solution engineering, including data pipelining and interop, backend development in Python, dashboard and Streamlit app development, and leveraging Databricks and Snowflake AI tools such as Genie and Cortex to create solutions in hours that used to take days. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a world-class team using best-in-class AI tools to take the music business to the next level. What You’ll Do Deliver Impactful Solutions for Diverse Stakeholders: Proven capability to step into different problem spaces and work with diverse people to turn work that takes weeks into minutes. Full-Stack Engineering: Ability to flex across backend, frontend, data pipelines, AI tools, Python, React. When you aren’t a pro at something, you can use AI effectively to deliver and you know how to make sure that the engineering stays excellent along the way. AI Solutions Delivery: Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to design, build, and deploy production solutions to accelerate non-technical stakeholders. Product Sense and Impact: Ability to rapidly understand and develop a solution without having curated requirements. You can step into a problem space with little context, rapidly understand what needs to be done, and deliver impact. Empathy and Customer Communication: Strong ability to communicate in non-technical language to stakeholders from entry to executive level. Proven ability to both manage expectations and keep customers up to date. AI Solutions Engineering: Familiarity working with AI tools such as Gemini, Cortex Code, and Genie Code, and you can wield them to turn solution delivery from weeks into hours. Be Curious and Adaptable: You are eager to explore new technologies and you are happy to flex across a variety of problems and domains by the day. You are comfortable with dozens of different problems for different stakeholders at any given time. Stay Aligned: Proven ability to contribute to standards and leverage existing tools and systems to ensure the FDE solutions are aligned with the Data and Insights engineering roadmap. Who You Are Experienced, Scrappy, and Creative: You have at least 3 years of software engineering experience. An ideal candidate will have exposure to customers, experience with Python, experience with data pipelining (e.g., ETL) and either Snowflake and/or Databricks (we build on both but one is sufficient for candidates). Ideally, you’ve already used Genie Code or Cortex Code, Notebooks, and Streamlit to some extent to deliver solutions. You’re imaginative and can think of ways to rapidly solve problems. Biased to Action and Impact: You have a strong focus on the customer with a bias to action to deliver value quickly. You are deeply motivated when you see pain points to fix them. You can take a manual, scrappy workflow that involved copy-pasting between tools and use AI to make it feel seamless. Lifelong Learner: You have a passion for learning and yearn for feedback, valuing the opportunity for daily growth. Mission-Driven: You are a music fan motivated by the fact that your work directly impacts an artist’s ability to grow their career and get paid. As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands. Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound. Love this job and want to apply? Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter. Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG. Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too. WMG is committed to inclusion and diversity in all aspects of our business. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and will evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, marital status, medical condition as defined by state law (genetic characteristics or cancer), physical or mental disability, military service or veteran status, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law. review_candidates.title: Financial Controller
review_candidates.description: Ubicación: Granada Sector: Construcción / Infraestructuras / Proyectos de gran escala Posición confidencial Buscamos incorporar un/a Financial Controller para participar en el control económico-financiero de uno de los proyectos estratégicos de mayor relevancia en la zona de Granada. La posición tendrá una alta exposición al proyecto y a la Dirección , asumiendo un papel clave en el seguimiento financiero, control de costes, análisis de desviaciones, reporting y monitorización de la evolución económica del proyecto. Buscamos perfiles con una sólida base analítica y financiera, especialmente aquellos/as procedentes de consultoría, Big Four, auditoría, advisory, controlling de proyectos o compañías internacionales de construcción, ingeniería o infraestructuras . Principales responsabilidades Liderar el seguimiento económico-financiero del proyecto , asegurando el adecuado control de presupuesto, costes, ingresos y rentabilidad. Participar en la elaboración, revisión y actualización de presupuestos, forecasts y previsiones de cierre . Analizar la evolución de costes y resultados, identificando desviaciones frente a presupuesto, forecast y objetivos , así como sus causas y posibles medidas correctoras. Elaborar reporting financiero y de gestión para la Dirección y otros stakeholders, proporcionando una visión clara de la evolución económica del proyecto. Realizar el seguimiento mensual de la contabilidad analítica , cuenta de resultados, balance y principales indicadores financieros. Analizar la evolución de cash flow, working capital, cobros, pagos y necesidades de financiación del proyecto. Monitorizar y reportar los principales KPIs económico-financieros , identificando tendencias, riesgos y oportunidades de mejora. Participar en la definición y mejora de procesos de control interno y control de costes , garantizando la calidad y trazabilidad de la información financiera. Coordinar y revisar los procesos relacionados con pagos, remesas bancarias y otros circuitos financieros vinculados al proyecto. Garantizar el adecuado control documental y financiero de la información del proyecto, de acuerdo con los procedimientos corporativos. Actuar como interlocutor/a con auditores internos y externos , así como con otros asesores y stakeholders financieros cuando sea necesario. Colaborar con las diferentes áreas del proyecto —finanzas, operaciones, compras, contratos y dirección de proyecto— para asegurar una visión integrada de la evolución económica. Participar en proyectos de análisis y mejora financiera ad hoc , proporcionando soporte analítico a la Dirección. Perfil que buscamos Titulación universitaria en ADE, Economía, Finanzas y Contabilidad o similar. 3-6 años de experiencia en posiciones de Financial Controlling, Project Controlling, FP&A, auditoría, advisory o consultoría financiera. Se valorará especialmente experiencia adquirida en Big Four, consultoría internacional, compañías de construcción, ingeniería, infraestructuras, real estate o gestión de proyectos de gran escala . Experiencia trabajando con presupuestos, forecasting, análisis de desviaciones, reporting financiero y control de costes . Sólida capacidad para analizar P&L, balance, cash flow, working capital y principales KPIs financieros . Capacidad para trabajar con información financiera compleja y transformarla en análisis accionables para la Dirección . Nivel de inglés B2 o superior , especialmente valorable experiencia en entornos internacionales. Nivel avanzado de Excel y soltura con herramientas de reporting, ERP y/o sistemas de gestión y control de proyectos. Perfil analítico, estructurado y orientado al detalle, con capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma y desenvolverse en entornos de proyecto exigentes. Capacidad de interlocución con diferentes áreas y niveles de la organización. Se valorará especialmente Experiencia en proyectos de construcción, infraestructuras, ingeniería o EPC . Experiencia en control económico de proyectos de gran volumen o elevada complejidad . Experiencia en entornos multinacionales o compañías con estructuras corporativas internacionales. Procedencia de Big Four, consultoría, auditoría, transaction/advisory services o departamentos de controlling/FP&A . Conocimiento de herramientas de project controls, ERP, BI o sistemas de gestión de costes . Disponibilidad para trabajar en Granada y, cuando sea necesario, desplazarse al entorno del proyecto. La oportunidad La posición ofrece la posibilidad de incorporarse a un proyecto estratégico y de gran dimensión , con elevada visibilidad dentro de la organización y exposición directa a la gestión económico-financiera del proyecto. Buscamos una persona que quiera asumir un papel relevante en financial controlling y project controls , combinando análisis financiero, control de costes y soporte a la toma de decisiones.
